dragToMoveAriaLabel.comment: Aria-label for the drag handle on a translation item
dragToMoveAriaLabel.fr-ca: Faites glisser pour déplacer la traduction
dragToMoveAriaLabel.ja: ドラッグして翻訳を移動

hideCommentAriaLabel.comment: Aria-label for the comment toggle button when comment is currently shown
hideCommentAriaLabel.ja: コメントを非表示にする

showCommentAriaLabel.comment: Aria-label for the comment toggle button when comment is currently hidden

moreActionsAriaLabel.comment: Aria-label for the more actions menu trigger button on a translation item

editAriaLabel.comment: Aria-label for the Edit menu item in the translation item actions menu

translateAriaLabel.comment: Aria-label for the Translate menu item in the translation item actions menu

deleteAriaLabel.comment: Aria-label for the Delete menu item in the translation item actions menu

noStatuses.comment: Screen-reader text shown in status breakdown when no translation statuses are available

moreLocalesX.source: { count, plural, =1 {1 more locale} other {{count} more locales} }
moreLocalesX.comment: Label on the expand button of a translation item, showing how many locale rows are hidden below the collapsed area
moreLocalesX.es: { count, plural, =1 {1 idioma más} other {{count} idiomas más} }
moreLocalesX.fr-ca: { count, plural, =1 {1 langue de plus} other {{count} langues de plus} }
moreLocalesX.de: { count, plural, =1 {1 weitere Region} other {{count} weitere Regionen} }
moreLocalesX.ja: { count, plural, other {他 {count} 件のロケール} }
moreLocalesX.ru: { count, plural, one {ещё {count} локаль} few {ещё {count} локали} many {ещё {count} локалей} other {ещё {count} локали} }

showLess.comment: Label on the expand button of a translation item when it is expanded and can be collapsed again

showMore.comment: Label on the expand button of a translation item when long values are clipped but no locale rows are hidden

compactLocaleAriaLabelX.comment: Screen-reader label for the locale badge on a compact translation item, naming which locale the displayed value belongs to and its translation status

baseLocaleTag.comment: Short tag shown beside the locale code when a compact translation item is displaying the base locale source text rather than a translation

keyTooltipX.comment: Tooltip on the translation item key chip: shows the untruncated resource key followed by the copy action. {key} is a dot-delimited resource key and is never translated.

copyKeyAriaLabelX.comment: Accessible name for the key chip button on a translation item header; names the full resource key that will be copied. {key} is a dot-delimited resource key and is never translated.

rollupAriaLabelX.comment: Accessible name for the translation status rollup on a translation item. {breakdown} is an already-localized, locale-joined list of status counts such as "2 stale, 1 new".

sameAsSourceTag.comment: Marker on a locale row whose translated value is byte-identical to the base locale value — it was never actually translated
sameAsSourceTag.ru: то же самое, что и источник

sameAsSourceAriaLabelX.source: {locale} is identical to the source text
sameAsSourceAriaLabelX.comment: Accessible description for a locale row whose value is byte-identical to the base locale value
sameAsSourceAriaLabelX.ja: {locale} はソーステキストと同一です
